description: This file defines a command handler class 'UnblockCreditsToSavingsAccountCommandHandler' responsible for processing 'UNBLOCKCREDIT' actions on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It integrates with the savings account write platform service to perform the unblocking operation when invoked.

classes.name: UnblockCreditsToSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface to handle 'UNBLOCKCREDIT' commands for savings accounts. It delegates the unblocking operation to 'SavingsAccountWritePlatformService'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the unblocking of credits on a savings account by invoking the write platform service with the savings account ID extracted from the JsonCommand.
